findings.title: Общая «Готово» недоступна во время WaterDraft
findings.cause: disabled={!!waterDraft || ...} blocks the existing onClick before finishPathDrafts -> finishWaterDraft can run.
reproduction: Build exact SHA; import test/fixtures/e6-water-editor.json (the included river-fixture.json also reproduces).
Select 0,0; enter Edit; choose lake in Water.
The common Done button becomes disabled. A real Playwright forced click leaves the one-cell WaterDraft open and commits no water. Local Finish selection remains usable.
findings.expected: Common Done must attempt the same water completion as Enter/local Finish selection, commit an uncomplicated valid edit once, and retain unresolved/error previews without exiting Edit or bypassing confirmations.
findings.observed: Common Done cannot be activated while any water draft/preview exists.
findings.risk: Required common Edit/Done workflow is unavailable. No data corruption observed.
findings.recommendation: Remove only the water-draft DOM gate while retaining busy gates and live completion/validation. Extend the existing focused lifecycle to use actual common Done on safe, conflicting and loss-preview drafts; verify one transaction and no bypass.
